messages:
rachel: Alert from provisioner: attach validation failures spiking in us-central1 on nodes with high scrub activity. sharing quickstats.

tom: What does the validation error look like? brief snippet?

priya: From controller logs:
```
2026-03-23T10:22:01Z attach-controller[pid=4321]: validate-local-index node=gc-usc-11 extent=0x9b1f err=CHK_MISMATCH
2026-03-23T10:22:01Z storage[pid=2110]: index-checksum failed id=0x9b1f expected=0x5c7a got=0x3d2b
2026-03-23T10:22:01Z janitor[pid=1400]: scrub started range=[0x9000-0x9fff]
2026-03-23T10:22:02Z attach-controller[pid=4321]: attach-reject node=gc-usc-11 reason=local-index-stale
```

luka: Checksum mismatch during scrub window -> index rewritten while attach validated against old hash. Looks racey.

rachel: Affected nodes: 12 in us-central1 and 2 in us-west1 (probing replication of scrub schedule). All are running scrub-scheduler v1.7.0 with aggressive overlapping windows.

tom: Is this causing evictions or just attach rejects?

priya: Mostly attach rejects leading to queued GPU requests. No data loss yet but extents flagged read-only on a few hosts until manual reconcile.

rachel: Mitigation ideas: 1) throttle scrubs (increase inter-window gap) 2) add index-confirm step to attach path to re-verify checksum after lock 3) temporarily prefer other regions for new attaches

luka: Easiest short-term: push routing override away from us-central1 for provisioning. Longer term: make scrub write atomic with index-rename and lock.

ops-bot: Running route change: set prefer-region=global weight us-central1=10 -> success (propagating 60s)

tom: Can we hotfix scrub-scheduler config to avoid overlap? which param?

priya: param 'concurrent_range_pct' set to 40% currently. Lowering to 10% should remove overlap for these cohorts. I'll roll a config change to the scheduler group.

rachel: Also add a temporary guard in attach-controller: if checksum mismatch -> fetch latest index and retry once. That prevents transient rejects.

luka: Can you open a small patch? I can review.

priya: PR ops/scrub-gap-2026 created. config change applied to 12 nodes as canary.

ops-bot: Config rollout to canary group completed. Monitoring attach success.

rachel: Early numbers: pending attach queue fell from 1800 -> 420 in 6m after routing + config canary.

tom: Cost note: cross-region fallbacks add egress. rough estimate $0.12/hr extra for high-throughput attach-heavy clusters.

luka: Postmortem actions we should capture: metric attach_checksum_mismatch, alert when >5/min; scrub scheduler default gap to 15s for cohorts; attach-controller retry-on-checksum.

priya: I'll include those in the follow-up ticket and schedule cleanup tool to reconcile read-only extents.

rachel: Thanks all. Once canary is green we'll k-roll scheduler config and backfill reconcile. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Incident saved: INC-20260323-scrub-checksum-race. Assigned: priya/rachel.
